correctness.rationale: Step 1 establishes the exact maximal-trace hitting lemma for finite posets; steps 2–3 prove necessity and sufficiency of the box signature by deletion and minimal symmetric difference; steps 4–5 prove the diamond signature through same-maximal-trace maximal co-witness obstructions and downset-complement instance tests with an outside-trace maximal scope. Step 6 connects equality of operations to equality of all modal formula truth sets via structural induction and variable valuations. Steps 7–8 prove sharp width cutoff, a persistence-respecting nonfaithfulness example and the complete constant-chain quotient. The standalone checker exhaustively compares both operations with their signatures over 1,100 local families per modality on eleven posets; finite checks corroborate but do not establish universal correctness.

This is a complete nontrivial family classification, not an isolated small example or arbitrary table.
